observations.text: The real bleeding is concentrated in the 78 suburban mall stores, where 24% of newly hired sales associates quit within their first 6 months due to chaotic weekend rosters and newly promoted store managers with zero people-management training.
Recent store-staff reviews repeatedly complain about unpredictable last-minute weekend shift changes, burnout during holiday peaks, and store managers who never give feedback or scheduling notice.
